name: e2e-suite
description: All-in-one self-evolving test suite: contract-based e2e skill family (orchestrator + 17 members — joint front/back-end testing, negative paths, persistence boundaries, UX acceptance, visual regression, API contract diff, performance probing, whitebox suites, canary self-evolution, harness-scaffold blueprint) PLUS an automated test gate (Stop-hook enforcement with auto baseline, flaky quarantine, regression blocking; TIA for pytest/go; per-runner failure parsing for jest/vitest/mocha/node --test/pytest/cargo/go/dotnet/CMake; MCP tools status/run/reset/family_skills with real before/after topological scheduling; platform-agnostic gate-core with CLI). One install, full functionality.

description_i18n.en: All-in-one self-evolving test suite: contract-based e2e skill family (orchestrator + 17 members) plus an automated test gate (Stop-hook enforcement, auto baseline, flaky quarantine, regression blocking, per-runner failure parsing, MCP tools, platform-agnostic CLI). One install, full functionality.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 一体化自进化测试套件：契约式联动测试技能家族（总控 + 17 成员——前后端联动、负向路径、持久化边界、UX 验收、视觉回归、API 契约比对、性能探针、白盒套件、金丝雀自进化、测试脚手架蓝图），外加自动测试门禁（Stop hook 收工把关：基线全自动、抖动隔离、回归拦截、无法评估显式告警；pytest/go 影响面选择；按运行器分别解析失败名；MCP 四工具（含家族发现入口 family_skills，真 before/after 拓扑编排）；判定引擎平台无关并带 CLI）。装一次，全功能。
